title: Jermalaines
content:
Jermalaines are finger-tall cave sprites who are almost as uncooperative and lazy as humans.

==Places==
*Jermalaines inhabit Hearthwright Green ([[19.01]]), where they grow [[jermalaine mushrooms|mushrooms]]
*[[Albus Flidge]] enslaved some jermalaines from Hearthwright Green and uses them to create delicate clockwork ([[29.14]])
*One of Albus' jermalaines is whispering to the [[Blind Doge]]
